title: Record the UX-01 merge runs and patch vite to 8.3.3 for new advisories
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Hosted run 39496608891 on pull request #3 passed both jobs at 3793081: design-system in about 3 minutes (30 checks, 150/150) and foundation with a 959 s pipeline step (886 s of stages). The Director fast-forwarded main from 9081192 to 3793081. Main run 39509517284 passed design-system and all 14 foundation stages, then failed the dependency advisory check. Source: public GitHub job and step metadata and the failed step's log; no artifacts downloaded.

Three vite 8.3.0–8.3.2 advisories in its bundled launch-editor were published 2026-10-20 18:30–19:51Z: GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm (high), GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv and GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw (moderate). The advisory policy rejects high findings. vite moves to 8.3.3, the first fixed release, in apps/web, packages/engine-lab, packages/design-system and vendor/tcg-engines; the lockfile changes only vite and the entries that reference it. pnpm audit reports no advisories.

RUN-20261020-043: isolated design-system suite passed in 107 s (30 gates, Chromium install, 150/150). RUN-20261020-044: isolated foundation pipeline passed all 14 stages and the dependency advisory check in 544 s (484 Node, 26 Python, upstream 406/1 skip, 2 injection, 13 web Chromium, Lab workers). Both at fingerprint b75b0513 with vite 8.3.3.
